arguments.command:
$env:PYTHONPATH=(Get-Location).Path
"=== AC10 file output ==="; python -m hone examples/example_a.csv $env:TEMP\out_a.json; "exit=$LASTEXITCODE"; python -c "import json;print(json.load(open(r'$env:TEMP\out_a.json'))[0]['name'])"
"=== AC11 stdout ==="; python -m hone examples/example_a.csv - | python -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(len(d), d[0]['birth']['month'])"
"=== AC11 stdin ==="; Get-Content -Raw examples/example_b.csv | python -m hone - - | python -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d[1]['b']['d']['f'])"
"=== AC12 help ==="; python -m hone --help | Select-String -Pattern "csv_filepath|json_filepath|--delimiters|--schema" | Out-String
"=== AC13 errors ==="; python -m hone nope.csv out.json 2>&1; "exit=$LASTEXITCODE"; python -m hone -d "not a list" examples/example_a.csv - 2>&1; "exit=$LASTEXITCODE"; python -m hone -s "[]" examples/example_a.csv - 2>&1; "exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
